name: ARAH Loss Function
definition: The total loss function used to train the ARAH model, combining RGB color loss, Eikonal regularization, off-surface point loss, and two other unspecified terms ($\mathcal{L}_I, \mathcal{L}_S$).
summary: The ARAH loss function optimizes animatable human SDFs by incorporating off-surface and inside point losses that leverage canonical SMPL mesh topology to enforce valid geometric representations.
